text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Yushun Himba (Oaks), 
Mejiro Dober asks if you believe in her 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When expressed heartfelt trust in Mejiro 
Dober, Mejiro Dober took those words 
firmly to heart and prepared to face the 
race...!
